_Description: Fallback protocol (see opts.protocol.fallback): 3D spoiled gradient-echo T1w without inversion of all vendors and field strengths (Philips T1W 3D FFE, Siemens FLASH, GE SPGR) with a higher flip angle than the inversion-recovery T1w and at least 0.8 mm slices (i.e. not the thinner slices of TOF angiography)
